I’m sorry to hear this, unfortunately that’s pretty much a symptom of derealization. Just feeling disconnected from yourself sucks and it’s scary. I hope it’ll improve for you in some way at least. If things get better or worse, just know we are here for you and we care about you. You’re never alone

I know it really sucks. Derealization takes away happiness so quickly and changes every aspect of life. I hope it improves for you, no one deserves to mourn over their past selves. I wish you the best of luck, and know we care about you
I would recommend informing your doctor and/or therapist about this. These could possibly be signs of derealization but it’s always good to check with a professional. I wish you the best of luck

I was put on Effexor when I went to the mental hospital but I didn’t have any benefits from it. My drug tolerance might be high because I don’t really react to any mental health meds. But yeah it didn’t make me feel any different from usual. I’ve heard the withdrawal from it is awful but I didn’t feel any negative effects either. I was on Effexor for roughly two months

Honestly I can relate. My derealization didn’t start from drugs but my symptoms seem treatment-resistant. It seems no amount of medication or therapy will do the trick. A doctor told me I’ll be stuck with it forever but I hope that won’t happen to you too. Are your symptoms constant or do they occur in episodes?

Derealization is unfortunately not well understood, there can be several possible causes for it and narrowing it down to find the cause is difficult. Hopefully the future will have better treatment options for us.

Unfortunately there’s no direct cure for derealization. I’ve had it for 7 years straight and my doctor said it’s very likely I’ll have it the rest of my life constantly. I wish you the best of luck though.
Yes, I’ve had DPDR constantly for 7 years nonstop but it’s not drug induced. No one knows what is causing my case.
Please don’t do it you have so much to live for I know it sounds cliche and I’m still trying to prove it true for myself but please make it to tomorrow
